objective: Test whether the two EXP208 source-selected centroid radii transfer to all 175 reciprocal embryo-held-out movies, and whether the new forward arm improves the confirmed EXP206 frontier when composed with fixed reverse parents.
evidence_grade: The radius family is development-adapted, but radius (3,5,5) forward and radius (2,3,3) reverse were selected only on two source checkpoint-validation movies per direction. Neither selected radius has been evaluated on the 175-movie confirmation cohort.
preregistered_outputs: both selected centroid directions versus raw base
selected forward plus EXP191 reverse versus raw base and EXP206
selected forward plus EXP195 reverse versus raw base and EXP206
primary_decision: Promote only a policy above EXP206 pooled OOF 0.6784542970776293 with paired evidence that is not concentrated in a few movies. Directional regression is diagnostic and must be reported even if pooled score rises.
ordering_gate: Compute all eight immutable chunk files, then validate exact 116+59 coverage and structure without emitting metrics. Only after PASS_EXP209_ALL_SELECTED_CENTROID_CHUNKS_NO_METRICS may chunks be merged and scientific metrics opened.

execution.restart_policy: single atomic launch; reconcile PID/start identity; never restart an ambiguous or partially written run

tests.command_scope: EXP209 validator, builder, runner/launcher contracts plus reused comparison and relocation verifier tests
